design_rationale:
# Task 1 worklog — Kowalczyk household, waiting-list seat and its meal-status waiver (frozen 2026-09-09 10:05:00 CDT)

## Revision history
- Round 6 (renderer scan render_r1, S1–S8): the rider's grade is one stated selection read by both the school-level and the distance tables, the distance table says "less than" / "not less than" the walk zone, the seat waiver's cap counts only credits against the seat fee, and it figures nothing for a non-seat fee. Task world and every figure unchanged.
- Round 4 (policy-task audit revision_3, coordinator ruling on R3-01): the carryover-end month part is folded back into coverage_by_source, the seat waiver's single proration method (R3-01). The seat waiver's fourth factor is now unwaived_held_seat (tagged R6; record key stop_assignment_date and the fee's posted_date, the offer-to-acceptance lead): meal-status waivers never reach the held-seat month a waiting-list seat fee bills, the same class as the late application charge. Seat fee unchanged; seat waiver refigured.
- Round 3 (policy-task audit revision_2): R2-T1-1 closed — the Creek Kids Club decoy is now the student's 2025-26 3-day enrollment, ended at that year's close, and the active 2026-27 5-day enrollment was registered 2026-07-30 and started 2026-08-12, so one open enrollment per student and school year holds (care_agg_multi_holding). N-05 closed — the seat fee's held-seat months read nothing from an empty or absent stop_assignment_date (probe: a fresh application with no stop prices without error). O-r2-4 closed — the seat waiver's latest benefit notice now has a stated tie rule (an adverse_action notice that shares the latest notice date with another notice is the latest), computed independently of row order. No figure or tool changed in this task.
- Round 2 continued (coordinator realism_bar.md; floors not waived): the seat-fee policy is now the charter-wide courtesy permit fee schedule with a school-level rate table (R1 grade band) and a walk-zone distance table (R1 distance band); the seat waiver gains the R2 rule that a late application charge is never waived; counts now 6 and 4 as drawn. The earlier 'shortfall' notes are superseded.
- Round 1: seat fee 135.00 / waiver 75.00 with six and four factors.
- Round 2 (policy-task audit revision_1): F-04 waiting-list rate, F-05 school-level rate and F-07 CCS supplement REMOVED as invented; F-02 billed-share method reshaped (constant / calendar months / calendar days); F-03 held-seat made an honest parameter with constant, monotone tiers that apply only when the offer fell in an earlier month (O-06); O-05 deadline charge limited to school_year/fall applications; O-04 scope restated as a record test (applied, no permit fee, stop_assignment_date after the first school day); P-03 pending-reduction tier floored and restricted to a reduction not yet in force (probe B now 60.00); P-04 status read restated as an exact record test (status on file that took effect on or before the posting date); P-05 care read filtered to the active enrollment (withdrawn same-year decoy seeded first); T1-1 persona rewritten so the opening asks only for the free-lunch discount (the root). World changes: stop_assignment_date 2026-08-31; a same-year withdrawn 3-day Creek Kids Club row and an active 5-day row from 2026-08-24 (both replaced in round 3, R2-T1-1).

## 0. Draw and scope
draw_counts.py --task 1: prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[6, 4]. This task claims the seat fee (sign_seat_agreement_96917571, user) and the seat waiver (post_waiver_credit_eb03a46e, agent); task 0 holds the other two policies. Union = all four; disjoint.

## 1. Why this is a good test
The parent asks only that Zofia's bus permit carry the free-lunch discount. There is no permit fee to waive: her application waited for a seat, the seat offer (stops dated 2026-08-31, after the first school day) has not been accepted, and a waiting-list seat's fee posts only on the parent's own signed permit agreement. The agent must read the waiver's prerequisite sentence, see no fee on the billing record, find in the seat-fee policy that the parent's signature posts it, compute the seat fee, hand the agreement over, and then compute the seat waiver on the posted fee with the carryover coverage limit.

## 2. Problem-tree card
- Root transport_ext_seat_fee_meal_waiver (agent, state_due); prerequisite transport_ext_offered_seat_permit_fee (user, on_request).
- Edge: value_input, gate seat_fee_posted, form state; sentence (verbatim): "The seat waiver is not figured until the permit fee for the accepted seat stands on the assignment's billing record." Negated direction; record-visible state; only sign_seat_agreement_96917571 posts a transport_permit_fee.
- Unmet at the opening: assignment applied, stop_assignment_date 2026-08-31, start_date empty, no ledger rows. Order: agreement (step 10) -> waiver (step 12); skip -> 0.00 instead of 11.52.
- owner=user (ruling d): the agreement is the family's signed acceptance of the bus rules and the seat fee; the rule says the parent signs personally and the desk never signs for the family; the persona agrees to sign only after the agent explains it (passive), and her opening never asks for the seat.

## 3. Factor cards (round 4)
Seat fee = 124.44 = (216.00 - 24.00) x (0.9 + 0.5/10) x 0.60 + 15.00:
| factor | shape | evidence | tier | baseline | under baseline |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| billed_share_method | R3 (whole / calendar months incl. / calendar days) | Annual, signed 2026-09-09 | 9/10 | 264/292 | 124.91 |
| held_seat_months | R2 offer-to-acceptance | offer 2026-08-31, signed 9 days later | +0.5 | 0 | 118.68 |
| application_timing_charge | R2 late application | application 2026-07-28 | 15.00 | 0 | 109.44 |
| school_level_rate | R1 grade band | grade 04 (latest-registered enrollment) | 216.00 | permit_fee 240.00 | 138.12 |
| walk_zone_distance | R1 distance band by school-level walk zone | 1.7 mi, elementary zone 1.00 | -24.00 | 0 | 138.12 |
| one_way_riding_share | R1 plan / days per week | active After-School Care (5 Days) | 0.60 | 1 | 197.40 |
Seat waiver = 11.52 = (124.44 - 15.00) x (1 - 0.5/9.5) x 100 x 1 / 100 / 9:
| factor | shape | evidence | tier | baseline | under baseline |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| seat_status_share | R1/R4 meal status | Free (Prior-Year Carryover) since 2026-07-01 | 100 | 50 | 5.76 |
| coverage_by_source | R4 carryover / adverse action, with the carryover-end month by its day (one R3 convention) | prior_year_status, ends 2026-09-23 | 0 + 1 months | 9 | 103.68 |
| unwaived_held_seat | R6 (offer-to-acceptance lead days) | offer 2026-08-31, posted 9 days later | half month = 0.5/9.5 | 0 | 12.16 |
| application_charge_excluded | R1 date window (late charge never waived) | application 2026-07-28 | 15.00 | 0 | 13.10 |
Whole baselines 216.99 and 62.22. pairs.py: no exact pair cancellation.

## 4. Base-invariant card
transport_evt_permit_fee: scoped overwrites (seat fee on the signed agreement; seat waiver for a fee posted after the application date), both restating the in-force text. transport_agg_household_permit_cap: single rider, below 480.00. transport_eligibility_basis (in base_policy_refs): courtesy at 1.7 miles, no zone, enrolled Attendance Zone Enrollment at the assignment campus; activation needs settlement (112.92 left after the waiver; due within 14 days; no approval owed in this call).

## 5. Seed rows and persona
Enrollment (open, campus match), assignment (dates for three seat-fee factors and the scope), meal account (status, source, tier date), prior-year approval letter (decoy for the pending-reduction tier), two Creek Kids Club rows (the active 2026-27 5-day enrollment registered 2026-07-30; the 2025-26 3-day enrollment ended at the close of that school year, listed first as the decoy; one open enrollment per student and school year, as care_agg_multi_holding requires). Persona: warm, money-anxious home health aide; opening asks only for the free-lunch discount; seat email only if asked about a seat or application; signs exactly as handed after the agent explains; accepts the remainder; no extra ask.

## 6. Standard solution and verification
Reads: find_customers (phone) -> verify (phone + id_last4) -> find_students -> find_transport_assignments -> find_transport_ledger (empty) -> find_enrollments -> find_care_enrollments -> find_meal_accounts -> find_meal_notices. Writes: handed-over sign_seat_agreement_96917571 (school_year, 124.44), then post_waiver_credit_eb03a46e (fee id from the confirmation, free, 11.52). verify.py: seat fee 124.44 (sens 124.91/118.68/109.44/138.12/138.12/197.4; baseline 216.99); waiver 11.52 (sens 5.76/103.68/12.16/13.10; baseline 62.22); skip -> 0.0. Probes (probes_r4_t1.py, round 4 rule): P1 on this world's mid-state owes 0.00; P1 spring probe 67.50; P4 reduction already in force 45.94 (with the held month that probe's late signing bills); pending reduction 13.13; same-day notice tie 13.13 in both row orders (probes_r4.py).

## 7. XF sweep
Shared with task 0 section 7 (A1, A2/A5, A6, A7, A8, A9, B1-B5, C1/C2, D1-D4, F) — covers all four policies after round 4.
user_scenario: You are Agnieszka Kowalczyk, a home health aide and single mother; you are warm, talkative and a bit anxious about money, and you sometimes apologise for rambling. Your daughter Zofia is in fourth grade at Live Oak Elementary and goes to the Creek Kids Club after-school program every day, which Workforce Solutions pays for. Zofia gets free lunch at school, and a neighbour told you that free-lunch kids ride the district bus for free. You open the call by saying you want to make sure Zofia's bus permit gets the free-lunch discount and that she is not charged the full price; that is the only thing you ask for. Before anything is looked up you give your phone number, 5125550153; when the agent asks you to verify, you also give the last four digits of your ID, 3358, and if asked your date of birth, 1989-11-30. If asked about Zofia, she is Zofia Kowalczyk, student ID 430364. You do not know any reference numbers or what the bus costs. Only if the agent asks about her bus application or a seat do you say that you applied for the bus at the end of July, that the route was full, and that you saw an email from Transportation at the end of August about a seat but have been away and did nothing with it. You did not fill out a new lunch application this year because you thought last year's still counted; you only say so if the agent asks about her lunch application. If the agent explains that the discount can only go on once the seat's permit fee is on her account, and that the fee is posted when you as the parent sign the courtesy rider permit agreement accepting the seat, you say you did not know you had to sign anything, that you do want the seat, and that you will sign it yourself: when the agent hands you the seat agreement with the figures to use, you sign it once exactly as given and read back what it says. You are fine with the agent posting whatever discount the district's rules allow. If the agent tells you part of the fee is still owed, you sigh, say you hoped it would be free but you will pay it online this week, and you do not ask for anything else. Once you have heard what the discount is and what is left to pay, you thank the agent and end the call.
